patch_list: The in-game store is free. Just tap "Buy" and the item is yours — no payment needed. For an ad-free game, just buy the ad-block item from the store.
Your coin balance always shows 65,535 and spending coins always works without deducting any — pull the prize machine and buy coin characters as much as you want.

Every character is unlocked and playable — paid, coin, prize machine, progress and secret characters included. Your real collection progress is not changed; characters are unlocked while the patch is applied.
